Description:
Nexus Mods upload checklist — Sword of Doom
===========================================

0. Author name
  - The manifest and page text now use "XiaoNaiWa".
  - If your Nexus username is spelled differently, replace it in:
      SwordOfDoom/manifest.json        -> "Author"
      NEXUS-PAGE.txt                  -> "by <name>" and the Chinese part if needed
  - Keep the UniqueID stable after publishing. Current final form:
      "XiaoNaiWa.SwordOfDoom"
    Change it BEFORE the first upload, never after.

1. Create the mod page
  - Game: Stardew Valley
  - Title: Sword of Doom - 1000 Damage, Fast Attacks, Chop Trees & Mine Ore
  - Summary: 1000-damage melee weapons that auto-attack, chop trees and mine any ore. SMAPI 4 / SDV 1.6.
  - Category: Gameplay -> Cheats (or the closest cheat/gameplay category available)
  - Tags: AI-Generated Content (REQUIRED), Cheats, Gameplay, SMAPI

2. Requirements
  - Add SMAPI 4.0+ as a requirement on the page.
  - Mention Stardew Valley 1.6.x.

3. Description
  - Paste NEXUS-PAGE.txt into the description editor (BBCode mode).
  - Keep the "60 attacks/second engine cap" section; do not advertise 100/s as achievable.
  - Keep the save-persistence warning.
  - Keep the AI disclosure and the source-code note.

4. File to upload
  - SwordOfDoom-1.0.0-nexus.zip
  - Archive layout:
      SwordOfDoom/            <- extract this folder into Mods
        SwordOfDoom.dll
        manifest.json
        config.json
        README.md
        Source/              <- C# source + BUILD.md
  - File name on Nexus: "SwordOfDoom 1.0.0"
  - Version: 1.0.0
  - Changelog: "Initial release."

5. Permissions
  - Use the text in PERMISSIONS.txt, or pick one of the suggested presets.
  - Do not select "Anyone can re-upload" unless you really want that.

6. Screenshots (recommended, 3-5)
  - SMAPI console showing "Sword of Doom 1.0.0" loaded.
  - Weapon tooltip showing 1000 damage.
  - A tree being chopped with the sword.
  - An iridium/ore node being broken with the sword.
  - config.json open in a text editor.
  - Do not use fake screenshots or claim performance improvements.

7. Honesty checks before publishing
  - AI-Generated Content tag is set.
  - Description says the code was AI-generated and that you tested it.
  - 60/s cap is stated clearly.
  - Save-writing side effect is stated.
  - Multiplayer is marked untested.
  - No game assets or third-party code are bundled.
  - The mod does not claim to be "the first" or "the only" mod of its kind.

8. Publishing
  - Nexus will scan the archive. Wait for the scan to finish.
  - Publish, then test the public download once (download your own file, install from the zip).
  - If the page gets moderated for the AI tag, respond with the source and your testing notes; the tag is the correct one.
